result.reason: The redline does not achieve the preferred position because it still permits minimum commitments in Order Forms. It also fails the fallback: commitments are not limited to the current 12-month term, are not reducible on 30 days’ notice, and do not use a true-up mechanism. The termination cross-references and ambiguous credit for unused commitment add unnecessary complexity and may alter payment economics without clearly eliminating take-or-pay treatment.
